scenarios.name: threat_silent_when_not_about_to_die
scenarios.note: Rebaselined for Phase 5 (2026-08-26): this fixture's own Hypnosis move now legitimately qualifies for the new SleepLead plan (nothing is threatening, the player is unstatused and unsubbed - exactly SleepLead's own qualification), which encourages slot 1 by AI_VERY_STRONG and ties it with slot 0's Swords Dance at 18. AI_THREAT itself is confirmed still silent (its own layer_trace delta is [0,0,0]) - the two sibling fixtures sharing this moveset (threat_takes_status_out_when_faster_and_dying, threat_suppresses_setup_but_not_status_when_slower) were re-checked and still pass unchanged, since AI_THREAT's own +10 discourage on slot 0 in the dying case dominates the same PLAN delta. This is the one board where nothing else pushes the scores apart, so the tie is visible only here. Reviewed via layer_trace, not blindly rebaselined.

scenarios.name: risky_silent_when_healthy
scenarios.note: Rebaselined 2026-09-01 for the expected-crit change (AIScaleDamageForCrit). The fixture's own subject is UNCHANGED and still verified: layer_trace shows RISKY's delta is [0,0,0,0], so AI_RISKY is still correctly silent while healthy. What moved is AI_DAMAGE, which now ranks Slash above Strength on this board and gives Slash the best-expected-damage nudge. That is arithmetically right and is the change's whole point: Slowpoke base speed 15 makes Slash's crit threshold 60/256 (23%) against Strength's 7/256 (2.7%), so 70 BP x 1.23 = 86 beats 80 BP x 1.03 = 82. Switched from pick_slot/score_lt to an EXACT scores array deliberately, so the fixture does not lose discriminating power: if AI_RISKY ever started firing here it would nudge Slash a second time and the array would read [18, 20, 20, 20], failing this test.

scenarios.name: plan_steers_toward_setup_when_nothing_is_dying
scenarios.note: Slower enemy, nothing in KO range: AgilityWrap qualifies and its directive encourages the AICLASS_BOOST_SPD slot by AI_VERY_STRONG, so Agility (15) beats Tackle (18). The -3 on slot 0 IS the plan layer.

scenarios.name: plan_yields_to_a_guaranteed_kill
scenarios.note: Same board with the player in one-shot range. The enemy now outspeeds, so the plan directs at the TRAP slot (-3 on slot 1) - but AI_DAMAGE has applied AI_KILL + its best-move nudge to Tackle (-6), which wins by one point. This is AI_PLAN_MAX_MAGNITUDE < AI_KILL being load-bearing: if a future retune lets a plan directive reach 5, a setup mon will walk past a won game and this fixture is what catches it.

scenarios.name: plan_required_mask_rejects_a_moveset_without_the_class
scenarios.note: Identical board to the positive case minus the trapping move. AgilityWrap's required mask no longer matches, selection falls through to the Bruiser fallback, and Bruiser deliberately issues NO directive - so Agility stays at 18 rather than 15 and ties with Tackle.

scenarios.name: plan_fitness_zero_when_its_key_move_is_type_immune
scenarios.note: Wrap is NORMAL and Gastly is a Ghost. Trapping respects type immunity in this engine (the check runs before set USING_TRAPPING_MOVE), so AIFit_AgilityWrap must return 0 rather than spend a turn on Agility setting up a move that cannot land. Confirmed by slot 0 showing only AI_TYPES' -1 and AI_SETUP's -2, with no -3 from the plan layer.

scenarios.name: plan_wraplock_traps_without_boosting_when_already_faster
scenarios.note: Enemy already outspeeds Slowpoke, so WrapLock (not AgilityWrap, which is not even a candidate without a speed-boost move) qualifies and encourages the TRAP slot directly.

scenarios.name: plan_sleeplead_isolated_no_confounding_setup_move
scenarios.note: Clean SleepLead check with no second qualifying plan on the board, unlike threat_silent_when_not_about_to_die which was rebaselined to a tie for this reason.

scenarios.name: plan_amnesiarest_heals_below_half_hp
scenarios.note: Below half HP: AmnesiaRest heals rather than boosts, per its execute routine.

scenarios.name: plan_amnesia_boosts_without_a_recovery_move
scenarios.note: No RECOVERY-class move, so AmnesiaRest's required mask rejects it and plain Amnesia wins.

scenarios.name: plan_toxicstall_poisons_then_would_heal
scenarios.note: Player unstatused, unsubbed, and not about to KO - ToxicStall qualifies and poisons first. Rebaselined 2026-09-02 for AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F14 (AISmart_Poison, ai_smart.asm): TOXIC's slot moved 17 -> 15. Confirmed correct, not a regression - before F14, POISON_EFFECT had NO AI_SMART handler at all, so this move's whole encouragement came from the ToxicStall plan directive alone. AISmart_Poison now ALSO independently encourages Toxic against a healthy, unstatused target (AI_STRONG, since AIPlayerHPBelowHalf is false for Electrode at full HP here) - it stacks with the plan's own directive rather than replacing it, which is exactly the intended behaviour: the plan layer and the move layer agreeing that Toxic is a good idea right now, from two different reasons. The other three unaffected fields (slots 1-3) are untouched.

scenarios.name: plan_chanseystall_paralyzes_then_would_heal
scenarios.note: Same shape as ToxicStall with paralysis: unstatused target, not about to KO.

scenarios.name: plan_parasweep_targets_a_currently_faster_player
scenarios.note: Player (Electrode) is faster than Snorlax - the fitness bonus for flipping the speed tier applies, and ParaSweep beats ChanseyStall's required RECOVERY-less moveset here since no recovery move exists on this board.

scenarios.name: plan_substall_recovery_shields_then_heals
scenarios.note: Splash deals no damage, so AISubWouldSurvive holds trivially; SubStall(RECOVERY) qualifies over bare SubSetup because its required mask (SUB|RECOVERY) is a superset.

scenarios.name: plan_substall_poison_shields_then_chips
scenarios.note: Same shape as the recovery variant with the SUB|POISON required mask instead. Rebaselined 2026-09-02 for F14 (AISmart_Poison): slot 1 (TOXIC) moved 20 -> 18. Same mechanism as plan_toxicstall_poisons_then_would_heal's rebaseline in this file - AISmart_Poison now independently encourages Toxic against a healthy, unstatused target (Electrode, full HP, AI_STRONG). The plan is still at step 0 here (Substitute has not gone up yet), so the plan layer has not yet touched TOXIC's slot at all - this -2 is entirely AI_SMART's own contribution, not a stack with the plan.

scenarios.name: plan_subsetup_shields_a_boost_move
scenarios.note: No RECOVERY or POISON class present, so both SubStall entries' required masks reject it and bare SubSetup (SUB only, gated on a boost move existing) wins instead.

scenarios.name: plan_bombtrade_preserves_the_user_below_quarter_hp
scenarios.note: Enemy below a quarter HP makes the trade worth it per AIFit_BombTrade.

scenarios.name: plan_ohkofish_gambles_when_losing_and_faster
scenarios.note: Equal levels so Fissure can legally hit (OHKO auto-fails when the attacker's level is below the target's - a real, separate veto AISmart_OHKO already owns and this fixture is not testing); enemy primed near death so AIPlayerWouldKO holds on its own merits. AI_STRONG (not VERY_STRONG) is deliberately modest since AI_RISKY may already be nudging the same move for the same reason. Rebaselined 2026-09-02 for AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F15 (the graded AI_RISKY ladder, ai_risky.asm): slot 0 moved 17 -> 16. OHKO moves are now detected EXPLICITLY by effect id and scored AI_STRONG within AI_RISKY, a tier above the generic unreliable-power/high-crit case (AI_NUDGE) - previously OHKO only reached AI_RISKY's single flat tier by an ACCIDENT of AIEstimateDamage always reporting 0/0 for OHKO_EFFECT, which happened to satisfy the 'well above reliable' comparison trivially. This fixture's own note already anticipated the interaction ('AI_RISKY may already be nudging the same move for the same reason') - the one extra point is that interaction becoming exact instead of coincidental.

scenarios.name: plan_swordsdance_boosts_without_a_confound
scenarios.note: No Hypnosis/Sub/Recovery on this board, so SwordsDance is the only qualifying plan besides the Bruiser fallback.

scenarios.name: setup_gate_blocks_statdown_with_no_physical_move
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F9 (the Krabby-Leer regression fix). Krabby's only other move is Bubble (WATER, special), so AIOwnsPhysicalMove correctly finds no physical move and AI_SETUP's usual AI_STRONG encouragement of Leer (DEFENSE_DOWN1_EFFECT) is suppressed - confirmed via layer_trace: SETUP's own delta is [0,0,0,0], where it would have been [-2,0,0,0] without the gate.

scenarios.name: setup_gate_allows_statdown_with_physical_move
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, Bubble replaced with Tackle (NORMAL, physical). AIOwnsPhysicalMove now finds a physical move and AI_SETUP's usual encouragement of Leer proceeds - confirmed via layer_trace: SETUP's delta is [-2,0,0,0], same as before F9 existed.

scenarios.name: redundant_statup_capped_saturates
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F17. Swords Dance (ATTACK_UP2_EFFECT) with the enemy's own Attack mod primed to the Gen 1 cap ($D/13). ai_tier 0 isolates AI_REDUNDANT alone. AIRedundant_StatUp saturates the move to AI_REDUNDANT_HEAVY (79) - before F17 this effect had NO entry in AIRedundantEffectTable at all, so a maxed-out stat-up move was never eliminated.

scenarios.name: redundant_statup_legal_below_cap
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, Attack mod at the default 7 (no boost applied yet). AIRedundant_StatUp correctly finds the stat not yet capped and leaves the score alone.

scenarios.name: redundant_statdown_floored_saturates
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F17. Growl (ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT) with the PLAYER's Attack mod primed to the Gen 1 floor ($1/-6). ai_tier 0 isolates AI_REDUNDANT alone. AIRedundant_StatDown saturates the move to AI_REDUNDANT_HEAVY (79) - the exact case this handler's own header describes correcting: engine correctness (CantLowerAnymore) already made this a safe no-op, but nothing previously told the AI a totally wasted turn was on offer. Diagnosed from a real battle where a Krabby kept using Leer long past the point it could do anything further.

scenarios.name: redundant_statdown_legal_above_floor
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, the player's Attack mod at the default 7 (not yet lowered). AIRedundant_StatDown correctly finds the stat not yet floored and leaves the score alone.

scenarios.name: charge_exposed_family_discouraged_normally
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F14. Razor Wind (CHARGE_EFFECT, fully exposed - no INVULNERABLE bit) against a healthy, unstatused player. AISmart_Charge applies AI_STRONG discourage - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta is [2,0,0,0]. AI_DAMAGE's own -1 (a real, separate contribution from the simulator crediting some damage) is present in both this and the paired stalling fixture, so the DIFFERENCE between the two fixtures' final scores isolates AISmart_Charge's own effect.

scenarios.name: charge_exposed_family_gets_no_stall_boost
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, player primed poisoned (a stalling condition). The exposed charge family (Razor Wind/Solarbeam/Skull Bash/Sky Attack) still eats a hit while charging even when stalling, so it gets NO boost, unlike the invulnerable family (Dig/Fly) below - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta is [0,0,0,0] here, not encourage. Only AI_DAMAGE's -1 (unrelated to stalling) differs the final score from baseline.

scenarios.name: charge_invulnerable_family_mild_penalty_normally
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F14. Dig (CHARGE_EFFECT, disambiguated by move id - grants INVULNERABLE) against a healthy, unstatused player. AISmart_InvulnerableCharge applies only AI_NUDGE discourage (smaller than the exposed family's AI_STRONG, since dodging a hit partially offsets the lost turn) - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta is [1,0,0,0].

scenarios.name: charge_invulnerable_family_boosted_when_stalling
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, player primed poisoned. Unlike the exposed family, Dig dodges the hit it would otherwise eat while charging, so stalling flips the penalty into a small encouragement - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta flips from [1,0,0,0] to [-1,0,0,0].

scenarios.name: evasion_tempered_outside_stall_context
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F14. Double Team (EVASION_UP1_EFFECT) against a healthy, unstatused player. AI_SETUP's existing blanket AI_STRONG encouragement fires unconditionally (delta [-2,0,0,0], unchanged by F14 - see the fixture's paired case for the same SETUP contribution), and the NEW AISmart_Evasion handler partially tempers it with a mild AI_NUDGE discourage since evasion has not yet been shown to matter - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta is [1,0,0,0].

scenarios.name: evasion_strongly_encouraged_when_stalling
scenarios.note: Same board as the positive case, player primed poisoned. AISmart_Evasion flips from a mild temper to a strong encouragement, since a lost turn costs nothing extra while the player is already losing HP/turns regardless - confirmed via layer_trace: SMART's delta flips from [1,0,0,0] to [-2,0,0,0], stacking with AI_SETUP's unchanged [-2,0,0,0].

scenarios.name: risky_metronome_fires_as_last_resort
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F15. Enemy primed near death (AIPlayerWouldKO holds, so AI_RISKY's own top-level gate does not bail out) with Metronome and a 0-power move (Mist) that no earlier layer touches, so nothing scores below baseline before RISKY runs. AIAnyScoreBelowBaseline correctly finds nothing better and nudges Metronome - confirmed via layer_trace: RISKY's delta is [-1,0,0,0], the only nonzero layer in the whole trace.

scenarios.name: risky_metronome_silent_when_something_already_better
scenarios.note: Same losing board, Metronome paired with Body Slam instead of Mist. Body Slam's real damage against a healthy Pikachu earns its own AI_SMART and AI_DAMAGE encouragement (slot 1 drops to 15, well below baseline) BEFORE AI_RISKY runs, so AIAnyScoreBelowBaseline correctly finds something already better and Metronome stays untouched - confirmed via layer_trace: RISKY's delta is [0,0,0,0] across every slot, where the positive fixture shows [-1,0,0,0] on Metronome's own slot.

scenarios.name: risky_ohko_tier_above_generic_risky_tier
scenarios.note: AI_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md follow-up F15. Equal levels so Fissure legally hits (the slower-auto-misses veto is AIRedundant_OHKO's job, not tested here); enemy primed near death so AIPlayerWouldKO holds on its own merits, and this same board also happens to qualify for the OhkoFish plan (AIFit_OhkoFish - see plan_ohkofish_gambles_when_losing_and_faster elsewhere in this file), which contributes its own -2 (AI_STRONG) via the PLAN layer. Fissure is now ALSO detected EXPLICITLY by effect id inside AI_RISKY and scored AI_STRONG there too, a tier above the generic unreliable-power/high-crit case (AI_NUDGE) - confirmed via layer_trace: RISKY's OWN delta is [-2,0,0,0], not the [-1,0,0,0] the old single-tier code would have produced via its accidental raw=reliable=0 collision for OHKO_EFFECT. The two -2 contributions (PLAN then RISKY) stack to the final score.
